description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class CommandHeaderInvalidException within the package org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.base. The class is used to signal invalid headers in commands, providing static factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects and including a builder class for mutable construction. It handles specific exception scenarios related to command header validation in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CommandHeaderInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception for invalid command headers, extending DittoRuntimeException. It contains static factory methods and a nested builder class for creating instances with specific headers, messages, causes, and related links.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with fluent API for constructing CommandHeaderInvalidException instances, allowing setting message, description, cause, href, and dittoHeaders before building the exception object.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance initialized with the header key that was invalid.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a CommandHeaderInvalidException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers, preserving other properties.
